description: Add or change the https webhook. It is POSTed on every band change and rebaseline, HMAC-SHA256-signed with the scoring key (header x-kyde-signature: sha256=<hex> over the raw body).

key.description: Scoring key; omit when sent as x-kyde-key header.

webhook_url.description: https URL, or null to remove the webhook (the key becomes poll-only).

name: set_webhook
title: Set alert webhook
